recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision revisits the modern BackboneType abstraction or the later FHIR-20487 decision to allow Meta in wildcard/open-type positions.
issue_request: FHIR-13363 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I STU3 change request to distinguish true datatypes from reusable structures, extend datatype diagrams to cover all categories, allow extension values using the then-approved type set, and allow modifier extensions on Dosage, Section, and Timing by using an explicit BackboneElement-style base plus related documentation.
initial_application: The issue was applied through the 2018 GF#13363 commit family: 895710265113b796cb75d13c9abf5cfe4aabf207 began datatype-related changes, dcd3ffda9020726ce3628f04603b19e4bf289c52 centralized wildcard/open type lists, c59c201a849833554f5f564eab2b32e2a217658d made Timing and Dosage carry modifier extensions, and 7508d2f2cbc6e6e4b77037539465e714c045a3d0 completed datatype page diagram and modifier-extension summary work.
additional_context: The current build refined the older literal BackboneElement wording to BackboneType for datatypes that may carry modifier extensions, while resource backbone components such as Composition.section still use BackboneElement. Later Published issue FHIR-20487 intentionally superseded the original Meta exclusion by adding Meta to wildcard/open-type locations, including Parameters and Extension. Related datatype diagram and ElementDefinition BackboneType audits for FHIR-13859 and FHIR-17404 already exist on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made because current source/fhir.ini keeps the affected sources active, source/datatypes.html and source/types.html describe the current categories and BackboneType behavior, BackboneType/Dosage/Timing/Composition.section structural sources preserve the modifier-extension behavior, and current wildcard/open-type behavior is correct after FHIR-20487.

related_jiras.note: The datatype special/meta diagram request was satisfied by the same #13363 diagram work and has already been separately audited on the combined branch.
ElementDefinition's modifier-extension lineage is part of the same BackboneType datatype family and has already been separately audited on the combined branch.
This later Published issue intentionally changed the original Meta exclusion by adding Meta to wildcard/open-type locations and has already been separately audited on the combined branch.
